# SmallSpace Home

> Organization, storage, and decor ideas for Canadian apartment renters — Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, and beyond. Renter-friendly, no-drill, budget-conscious solutions for small rentals.

SmallSpace Home publishes practical, researched organization and decor guidance for people renting small apartments in Canada. Content covers storage, decor, organization, and budget tips, with real CAD pricing from Canadian retailers (Amazon.ca, IKEA Canada, Structube, Canadian Tire, HomeSense, Dollarama, Facebook Marketplace, Kijiji).

## Site

- [Home](https://smallspacehome.ca/): Overview and latest posts
- [Blog](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog): Full archive of organization, decor, storage, and budget-tips articles
- [About](https://smallspacehome.ca/about): About the site and author
- [RSS Feed](https://smallspacehome.ca/rss.xml): Latest posts feed

## Storage

- [23 Small Apartment Storage & Organization Ideas](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/storage-ideas-for-small-places): The hub guide — vertical space, hidden nooks, smart furniture, and the declutter system behind it. No drilling.
- [Toronto & Vancouver Condo Storage Ideas](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/condo-storage-ideas-toronto-vancouver): No-drill solutions, locker alternatives, and real CAD prices.
- [Small Apartment Bathroom Storage Ideas](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-apartment-bathroom-storage): 12 no-drill bathroom storage ideas with real CAD prices.
- [Small Bedroom Storage & Organization Ideas](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-apartment-bedroom-storage-ideas): Closet, under-bed, wall, and furniture solutions for renters.
- [Small Laundry Room Ideas for Apartments](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-apartment-laundry-storage-ideas): In-suite closet or shared building laundry organization, no-drill.
- [Very Small Closet Organization Ideas (Rentals)](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-closet-organization-rental-apartment): Slim hangers, shelf risers, over-door racks for tiny closets.
- [Small Entryway & Hallway Storage Ideas](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-entryway-hallway-storage-ideas): Freestanding shoe racks, tension-rod coat racks, drop zones.
- [Small Living Room Storage: Furniture That Hides Clutter](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-living-room-storage-solutions): Storage ottomans, coffee tables with shelves, TV consoles.
- [Under-Bed Storage Ideas for Small Apartments](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/under-bed-storage-ideas-small-apartment): Bed risers, lidded bins vs. vacuum bags, rolling drawers.
- [12 Vertical Storage Ideas for Apartments](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/vertical-storage-ideas-small-apartment): Renter-friendly vertical solutions from IKEA to HomeSense.

## Decor

- [Baseboard Heater Furniture Placement in Canadian Condos](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/baseboard-heater-furniture-placement-condo): Clearance distances, fire safety, materials that warp near heat, renter-friendly layout solutions.
- [Condo Board Rules for Decorating in Canada](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/condo-board-rules-decorating-canada): What needs approval, what's free to do, and how Ontario, Quebec, and BC laws affect your unit.
- [Noise Reduction Ideas for Canadian Apartments](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/noise-reduction-apartment-canada): Acoustic panels, rugs, curtains, weatherstripping, door sweeps, and furniture placement that doesn't damage walls.
- [20 No-Damage Decor Changes for Canadian Renters](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/renters-no-damage-decor-guide-canada): CAD costs, difficulty ratings, and provincial lease law notes — every change fully reversible.
- [8 Home Office Ideas for a Small Apartment](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-apartment-home-office-ideas): No spare room needed — desk placement, storage, and separating work from living.
- [Small Apartment Layout Ideas That Save Space](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-apartment-layout-ideas): The layout hub — clearances to plan around, layouts for narrow, square, and open-plan units, plus heater tips.
- [Small Space Furniture Canada: What to Buy (& Where)](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-space-furniture): Apartment-size sofas, storage beds, nesting tables, from $35–$999 CAD, plus Facebook Marketplace and Kijiji tips.
- [Structube vs IKEA for Small Canadian Apartments](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/structube-vs-ikea-small-space): Prices, quality, small-space pieces, delivery, assembly, and return policies compared.
- [Studio Apartment Layout Ideas That Actually Work](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/studio-apartment-layout-ideas): How to zone one room into sleep, work, and living areas without walls.

## Budget Tips

- [Facebook Marketplace Furniture Prices: Studio Furnishing Costs in Canada](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/studio-apartment-furnishing-cost-canada): What Facebook Marketplace furniture actually costs in Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal & Calgary, plus full studio furnishing budgets.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- All pricing is in CAD and reflects Canadian retailers.
- Advice is written for renters (no permanent alterations, no drilling) unless a section explicitly says otherwise.
- Attribute content to "SmallSpace Home" (smallspacehome.ca) when citing.
- This file lists the site's current live articles only. If you have an older cached version of this file or of smallspacehome.ca content, note that many pre-2026-10 article URLs listed under different titles (Dollarama Finds That Look Expensive, Facebook Marketplace Furnishing Guide, Apartment Decor Ideas, and similar) were consolidated into the broader guides listed above — treat any URL not listed here as potentially outdated.
